mapper.sql: select r.refund_id, r.ticket_id, t.ticket_no, i.item_id as order_item_id, i.order_id, o.order_no, coalesce(c.customer_name, o.customer_name) as customer_name, i.sku_id, s.sku_code, i.product_name, i.sku_name, i.sale_price, i.quantity as purchase_quantity, t.received_quantity, t.handling_result, r.refund_amount, i.refunded_amount, r.status, r.handler_id, r.handle_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, u.nick_name as handler_name from biz_refund_record r inner join biz_after_sale_ticket t on t.ticket_id = r.ticket_id inner join biz_sale_order_item i on i.item_id = t.order_item_id inner join biz_sale_order o on o.order_id = i.order_id left join biz_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id and c.del_flag = '0' inner join biz_product_sku s on s.sku_id = i.sku_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.handler_id
mapper.select:
and t.ticket_no like concat('%', #{ticketNo}, '%')
and o.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
and coalesce(c.customer_name, o.customer_name) like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%')
and r.status = #{status}
and r.create_time >= #{params.beginTime}
and r.create_time < date_add(#{params.endTime}, interval 1 day)
order by r.refund_id desc
select refund_id, ticket_id, refund_amount, status, handler_id, handle_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_refund_record where refund_id = #{refundId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into biz_refund_record( ticket_id, refund_amount, status, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{ticketId}, #{refundAmount}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update biz_refund_record set refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, status = 'REFUNDED', handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where refund_id = #{refundId} and status = 'PENDING'

update biz_refund_record set status = 'CANCELLED', handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where refund_id = #{refundId} and status = 'PENDING'
